name: Sum on Subarrays
title: C. Sum on Subarrays
input_spec:
The first line contains one integer t (1≤t≤5000) — the number of test cases.

Each test case consists of one line containing two integers n and k (2≤n≤30; 0≤k≤
(n+1)⋅n


2
).
output_spec: For each test case, print n integers — the elements of the array meeting the constraints. It can be shown that the answer always exists. If there are multiple answers, print any of them.
